title: Launch film deep-dive (Sep 23)
ev: Golden-hour shot: a man relaxes on a lounger by an infinity pool (no UI shown)
He reaches for a notebook / laptop on the lounger
Close shot: he glances at the screen, then looks away, unbothered
Text fades in: "not everything needs you."
Text clears; he sets the screen aside
Text: "we will handle everything and tell you what does."
Camera pulls back and rises above the pool terrace
Aerial wide shot; Agently logo resolves
